claim: Soft thought tokens remain effective when applied to different large language model architectures, including cutting-edge models.
falsifier: Apply soft thought tokens to a held-out LLM architecture not used in the study and measure performance relative to a zero-shot CoT baseline.

conditions: when applied to LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, and Qwen3-8B
exclusions: Evidence is limited to the three model variants tested; transfer to other architectures or scales is unestablished.

title: Soft thought tokens–consistent effectiveness across model principle
